title: Finite etale covers of normal punctured spectra are equivalent to finite normal algebras
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The global sections of a finite etale cover must be proved finite over the local base, despite the punctured spectrum being nonaffine. The proof identifies these sections with an integral closure by localizing along the puncture and using reflexivity and depth-two Hartogs extension, thereby constructing the inverse equivalence.
